_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Lîstikvan Maran li ser grîdek {width}×{height}.
Tu marê {player_id} kontrol dikî. Hereketên derbasdar: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (an jî w/s/a/d).
Armanca: herî zêde bijî an jî herî dirêj û herî zêde skor bistîne (sînora gera {max_turns} geran).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} ji ber tevgera neheq mir.

outcome.survived_win: Lîstikvan {player_id} sax ma; hemû yên din mirin.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Hemû şêrîn di heman demê de mirin.
outcome.outlived: Player ji hemû yên din re dereng ma.
outcome.turn_limit: Sînorê guherandinê gihîşt - herî baş skor tie-break qezenc dike.
